# 40 Hour HAZWOPER

> Take the OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER online under 29 CFR 1910.120(e). General, construction, remediation, oil & gas, pipeline and fire/hazmat tracks. $249.99, certificate included.

40 Hour HAZWOPER (https://forty-hour.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs 40 Hr · General, 40 Hr · Construction, 40 Hr · Remediation, 40 Hr · Oil & Gas Spill or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://forty-hour.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Guides

- [40-hour or 24-hour HAZWOPER: which one does your job need?](https://forty-hour.hazwoperosha.us/guides/40-hour-or-24-hour-hazwoper): OSHA ties the hours to your exposure, not your job title. Here's how to tell which initial course applies.
- [The three days of field experience: what online training can't do for you](https://forty-hour.hazwoperosha.us/guides/hazwoper-field-experience-three-days): The 40-hour has two parts. The course covers the classroom part. Here's how employers handle the supervised days on site.
- [Construction, remediation, oil & gas, pipeline or hazmat: picking your 40-hour track](https://forty-hour.hazwoperosha.us/guides/choosing-a-40-hour-industry-track): All six 40-hour courses meet the same OSHA requirement. The track decides which examples, hazards and scenarios you'll study.
